title.zh: 3rd Yandex Cloud Data Center Was Hit
title.en: 3rd Yandex Cloud Data Center Was Hit

current_state.zh: Yandex Cloud's status page reported an incident in which a third of its data centers was hit, prompting Hacker News discussion about the targeting of commercial compute infrastructure in war and its implications for future data center design.
